issueInvoice.confirm: Are you sure you want to issue an invoice for order <bold>{orderNumber}</bold>? An issued invoice cannot be cancelled here.
issueInvoice.title: Issue invoice

printInvoice.reprintConfirm: Reprint the invoice for order <bold>{orderNumber}</bold>? The original has already been printed, and a reprinted copy is not eligible for the lottery. If the original never came out of the printer, reset it to not printed first.
printInvoice.title: Print invoice

resetInvoicePrint.confirm: Reset the invoice for order <bold>{orderNumber}</bold> to not printed? Do this only if the original never came out of the printer — after resetting, the next print produces a second prize-eligible original.
resetInvoicePrint.success: Invoice for order {orderNumber} reset to not printed
resetInvoicePrint.title: Reset to not printed

confirm.cancel: Are you sure you want to cancel {count, plural, one {order} other {orders}} <bold>{orderNumbers}</bold>? This action cannot be undone.
confirm.default: Are you sure you want to change {count, plural, one {order} other {orders}} <bold>{orderNumbers}</bold> to <statusText>{status}</statusText>?
